pages.text: Utilising Sandpaper on spruce logs will yield a large piece of Cinnamon Bark, which can be cut in a Mechanical Saw into Cinnamon Sticks.

Combining Flour, a Ginger Root, and a Cinnamon Stick together in a crafting grid will provide some Gingerflour. This can then be washed, similar to regular flour, into Gingerdough, then smoked into a Loaf of Gingerbread.

Sending a Gingerbread Loaf into a Mechanical Saw will result in the creation of Gingerbread Cookies, of which can be used to decorate your builds or as a small treat for the holidays!$(br)There are additional variants that serve the same purpose, just differing in texture.
